title: Anthropic's IPO blows past its expected price range
hook: 跑道盡頭立著一道寫著 $70–78 的終點門，一顆 $83 的氣球順著強風衝了過來。
bridge: 風不只吹過終點門，還順手把樹上的蘋果吹進了創辦人的籃子。
p: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, CNBC reported on Nov. 18, above the expected range of $70 to $78. The company sold about 980 million shares, up from a planned 825 million, and raised $81.3 billion. That is the largest IPO on record, ahead of SpaceX's offering in June. The final price {0} the expected range, and trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT was due to begin on Thursday.

A group of tech companies, including Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and AMD, agreed to invest $26 billion at the IPO price. Each of the seven co-founders is selling 3.38 million shares, for total proceeds of $1.96 billion, a {1} few startup founders ever see. Amazon and Google already hold stakes worth more than $100 billion each.

words.def: to go well beyond a limit, target or expectation
words.mn: 終點門上寫著 $70–78，$83 的氣球被一陣強風吹得呼嘯而過，連門都沒碰到。風把東西吹過去，就是遠遠超過預期。
words.ex: The startup blew past its sales target in the first month.
words.exZh: 這家新創在第一個月就遠遠超過了銷售目標。

words.def: a large sum of money received unexpectedly
words.mn: IPO 的強風一吹，樹上的蘋果（fall）全被風（wind）吹落，剛好掉進創辦人的籃子，裡面裝著 $1.96B。風吹落的果實，就是意外之財。
words.ex: The tax refund was a welcome windfall for the small bakery.
words.exZh: 那筆退稅對這家小麵包店來說是一筆及時的意外之財。

quiz.q: Sales ___ every forecast this quarter, so the team got a bonus.
quiz.why: blew past 是遠遠超過。dipped under 是低於，brushed off 是不當一回事。

quiz.q: The unexpected inheritance was a ___ for the struggling family.
quiz.why: windfall 是意外之財。setback 是挫折，stopgap 是臨時應急的辦法。
